lines: | **`benchmark/2026-10-03-u14-native-abi-gecko/`** | **Stopped at the reproduction gate: libwestlake_native_abi d2053066 (source + build-abi.sh + receipt found in bms-deploy 44b8e0b0ad) was compiled by the frozen Linux x86-64 clang feef13a3, which cannot run on the Mac; the Mac DevEco clang 99548401 build 1e2726d9 (x2 identical) is 31/31 instruction-equal and all PT_LOAD bytes equal (build-id, e_shoff masked) but differs in .comment/.debug_str/build-id; options: a2hlab after the window, hw248 + path remap, or accept the Mac baseline. android_dlopen_ext semantics source = AOSP 14 r1 bionic libdl/linker on hw248.** |

- 2026-10-03 **复现 native 件前先看它自己的 DWARF producer / .comment(cc-t3,native_abi d2053066)**:回执写的是 frozen 工具链目录,但真正用的编译器修订只有二进制自己知道——d2053066 两个 CU 都是 clang 15.0.4 feef13a3,即 frozen toolchain 的 Linux x86-64 clang-15(在挂载 /Users 的 Linux VM 里编,comp_dir 是 Mac 路径),Mac 上跑不了;Mac DevEco clang 是 99548401、BiSheng 2ed87471。Mac 版 1e2726d9 与 d2053066 31/31 函数指令等价、4 个 PT_LOAD 掩掉 build-id 与 e_shoff 后逐字节同,只差 .comment/.debug_str/build-id。『行为等价』与『字节等价』分开报(benchmark/2026-10-03-u14-native-abi-gecko/elf_load_and_symtab.py)。
